role: Semantic traversal query functions for Co-Being knowledge graph with hard depth/confidence constraints
detail: Enforces MAX_SEMANTIC_DEPTH=5 and MIN_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR=0.3 per Atlas domain (CANON A.1, A.10, A.11). Core exports: SemanticTraversalRow (single subject-edge-object result), SemanticQueryResult (full traversal result container with metadata), SemanticQueryConstraints (configurable depth/confidence/scope/retraction/limit controls). Query functions: query_active_semantic_edges (single-hop edges of specified types), query_is_a_ancestors/descendants (multi-hop IS_A taxonomy traversal with depth limit), query_has_property_edges (HAS_PROPERTY with optional property_type filter), query_categorical_facts (edges meeting scope_context_count threshold), query_by_edge_type (generic edge queries by type with optional source/target anchoring). Write-time integrity: check_is_a_cycle (detects taxonomy inversions), check_direct_conflict (HAS_PROPERTY/LACKS_PROPERTY negation conflicts, IS_A inversions). Atomic MERGE-based merge_or_update_semantic_edge for race-condition-safe concurrent edge creation/updates. All queries use Neo4j relationship property indexes (sem_{type}_scope, sem_{type}_valid) when type is pinned in MATCH; temporal queries filter on valid_to IS NULL for active edges. Mitigates IS_A hub fan-out via depth cap, confidence pruning, and optional scope_context_count >= threshold gating. Records use prop_ prefix convention (from Neo4jGraphPersistence). P1.8 performance target: all queries complete within 100ms.
gotchas: Hub fan-out risk at IS_A concepts (animal, object, thing); mitigated by depth/confidence/scope_context_count gates. Variable-length paths [r:IS_A*1..N] exploited; ancestor/descendant queries return last() relationship not direct edge. MERGE discriminator includes prop_property_type for HAS_PROPERTY/LACKS_PROPERTY to avoid composite-key collisions. Edge properties use prop_ prefix (caller responsible for convention). Cypher MERGE on (source_id, target_id, edge_type, prop_property_type) ensures atomicity vs concurrent writes. scope_context_count NOT auto-incremented by merge_or_update_semantic_edge — delegated to ScopeContextMechanics.increment_scope_count(). Retracted edges (valid_to NOT NULL) excluded by default. Property-type constraint only applies when non-None (composite key for HAS_PROPERTY conflicts). No validation of edge_type format — caller must ensure alphanumeric + _; Neo4j will reject bad syntax.
